name: chat-ax

scripts.build: node build.mjs && vite build && node scripts/remove-built-secrets.mjs
scripts.dev:test: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.test.jsonc --port 8787

description: A shared team chat where everyone talks to one durable AI agent fleet. Runs entirely on your Cloudflare account.

AI.description: Runs the agents. Models are served by **Workers AI** and **AI Gateway** on your own account; no outside API keys are needed.

FILES.description: Stores files people attach in chat. Keep the default name unless it clashes with an existing bucket.

WORKER_NAME.description: Keep this equal to the Worker name above. The first-run setup page uses it to link you to the right dashboard page.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Keep `default`. Cloudflare creates the default **AI Gateway** automatically on the first request, giving you logs and spend controls.
